title: Weather
description: Resolves your city from IP and gives one-click next 7 days / 14 days / month forecasts, plus historical lookback and custom ranges.
searchPlaceholder: For example: Beijing, Shanghai, Tokyo, Singapore
locationPending: Resolving your default city, or search for a place manually.
rangeHint: A single query spans up to {{days}} days; forecasts reach {{date}} at the furthest.
empty: No weather data yet. Resolve a location or search for a city, then apply a range.

notes.note1: On load the page resolves your city from IP and immediately fetches current conditions plus the next 7 days.
notes.note2: Next 7 / 14 days come from the Open-Meteo daily forecast (16 days max); the tail of Next Month comes from ensemble data and is badged "Outlook".
notes.note3: Last 7 / 30 days are for historical review; a custom range straddling today merges archive and forecast data automatically.
notes.note4: A single query spans at most {{days}} days. If IP lookup fails, search for a city in Chinese or English.

errors.missingDate: Please choose both a start date and an end date
errors.invalidRange: The start date cannot be later than the end date
errors.tooLong: A single query cannot exceed {{days}} days
errors.futureLimit: Future weather is only available through {{date}}
errors.locationRequired: Please resolve your current location or search for a city first
errors.generic: Weather lookup failed. Please try again later.
errors.ipLocateFallback: IP-based default location failed. Search for a city manually to continue.

outlookHint: Beyond the 16-day daily forecast window; from ensemble data, use as a trend only
outlookNotice: {{days}} day(s) fall beyond the 16-day detailed forecast window and come from ensemble data — treat them as a trend.
